title: Phase 2: the return — net + target region + paddle orientation (config toggles), memoryless return detection, ≥70% of serves returned into far court, curve + gif
notes: Env fixes all merged (PRs #7-#11): net-clearance serves, lively 2m paddle face, intercept-point shaping with baseline anchor, pace bonus, tilt centering spring (random tilt exploration was laying the face flat — contact pinned at random 11% in runs 2-3). Two laptop runs stopped externally; per SPEC compute budget the 20M-step run belongs on Colab: clone repo, pip install uv, uv run python scripts/train_tennis.py --phase2. Trainer logs contact + returned rates per eval. Probe evidence: scripted swing policy returns 20/40 upright, so >=70% is reachable.
close_reason: Phase 2 complete via PRs #7-#14: final 1000-serve eval 71.7% returned (target ≥70%, recent evals 67-72%), honest contact ~97%. Six runs, three reward hacks found and killed: (1) net-rebound phantom returns at eval #1, (2) dead paddle face made returns impossible, (3) net-pinning contact farm at 8M steps (contact 3170%). Root-cause chain: paddle solref, 2m face, intercept shaping + baseline anchor, tilt channel dropped after bisection (orientation → Phase 3 curriculum), receiver-zone joint limit. Artifacts: docs/phase2_curve.png, out/phase2_rollout.html (user records gif).
